maddeler.e:
أتعاقب (form VI)
# أَتَعَاقَبُ (ʔataʕāqabu) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.qa.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَعَاقَبَ (taʕāqaba)
# أَتَعَاقَبَ (ʔataʕāqaba) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.qa.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاقَبَ (taʕāqaba)
# أَتَعَاقَبْ (ʔataʕāqab) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.qab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَعَاقَبَ (taʕāqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
